findings.description: The bucket has no server_side_encryption_configuration block, so stored report contents are not encrypted with a customer-managed KMS key as required for regulated data. Objects placed here (e.g. the vendor-roster.xlsx seed object) rest under only default AWS-managed encryption, giving no control over the key.
This bucket holds financial ledger exports but defines no server_side_encryption_configuration, leaving sensitive financial records without an explicit KMS-managed encryption-at-rest control.
Although versioning and access logging are enabled, the bucket has no server_side_encryption_configuration block, so model artifacts are stored without an explicit encryption-at-rest key.
The bucket defines no server_side_encryption_configuration, so operational runbooks are stored without an explicit encryption-at-rest control.
